content:
Jules: Pushed a compact-version mock for the SLO/alert thresholds + suppression editor. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/alerting-compact — main asks: reduce vertical density of threshold rows, show a live notification preview that SRs can pick up, and make suppression editing keyboard-first. Pls drop quick nits. :eyes:

Arjun: Nice start. Two quick layout thoughts: 1) going from 32px -> 16px vertical padding feels aggressive for hit targets. Recommend ~20-22px row height and larger tappable areas for thresholds. 2) channel chips should wrap with a "+3" style overflow chip instead of truncating text.

Nora: Accessibility check: the preview region MUST be announced. Wrap it in an aria-live region (polite) and prepend "Preview:" text so screen readers read a stable label. Also color contrast: the orange warning (#F5A623 on white) fails AA. Need darker tone or bold border.

Sam: Copy nits: change "Notify when > X errors in 5m" -> "Notify after X errors in 5 minutes" (less ambiguous). Preview examples should include channel avatars and a small indicator like "(test)" so customers know it's a simulated send.

Dena: Mobile note: compact rows push the timestamp and controls offscreen. Suggest collapsing advanced options (grouping by chevron) and using a two-line chip layout on narrow widths. Also add a quick-snooze shorthand in suppression: type "snooze 2h" -> populates until field.

Mina (a11y): On keyboard flow: when you add a suppression and submit, move focus to the newly created suppression entry for confirmation. For toggles use role=\"switch\" and aria-checked. For preview ephemeral text, prefer role=\"status\" for instant SR announcement.

Arjun: Implementation thought: add a top-right "Compact" toggle that switches density presets rather than trying to jam both into one layout. Also suggest keyboard shortcut `Cmd+K` style to open "add channel" quick modal. Small CSS snippet for preview region I used in the demo:

```
<aside role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\">
  Preview: Sent to #alerts, slack-app, email (masked)
  Message: \"Service latency > 300ms for 5m — triggered SLO alert\"
</aside>
```

Nora: +1 on focusing new items. Also: announce when suppression will end with humanized time ("snoozed for 2 hours, ends at 3:12pm"). That reduces confusion for SR users.

Sam: UX tweak — in the notification preview show the sending identity: "Preview as Redwood Alerts" with a small dropdown to choose persona (system / owner / test). Also truncate long channel lists and add a hover tooltip to expand.

Design-Bot: Uploaded v2 with annotations: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/alerting-compact?node-id=42:128 (a11y notes included). :white_check_mark:

Jules: Solid feedback — plan of action: Arjun will prototype row-density + compact toggle; Nora + Mina will draft accessibility acceptance criteria; Sam will do a copy pass and add preview persona wording; Dena will compile mobile testcases and the natural-language snooze grammar list. I'll schedule a 30m sync Friday 10:00am PT to review the prototype. Thanks all! :raised_hands:

Arjun: I'll put a quick prototype branch up and ping the thread when ready. :thumbsup:

Nora: I'll start an a11y checklist doc and link it here.

Sam: Copy pass inbound by EOD Wednesday.

Dena: Mobile testcases will be in the ticket.

Jules: awesome — marking this as in-design for now. If anyone sees any blocker before Friday call pls shout here. :megaphone:
